name: STAR Statistics — n-sigma coverage in 1, 2 and 3 dimensions
summary: Coverage, tail probability and inverse of n sigma for a Gaussian error in one, two and three dimensions, and the normal distribution function and quantile; within 1.9e-13 relative of mpmath at 40 digits and 2.4e-13 of SciPy on 600 cases, tails included; reproduces the published normal and chi-square tables.
reference: Abramowitz and Stegun, table 26.1: coverage of 1, 2, 3 sigma = 0.6826895, 0.9544997, 0.9973002; Phi(1.959964) = 0.975000

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: normal_cdf(), normal_sf(), normal_quantile(), sigma_coverage(), sigma_tail(), sigma_for_coverage()
review.G-04: probabilities in [0, 1]; n in units of sigma; the number of dimensions is an explicit argument
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; bisection capped at 200 steps; the Gaussian assumption stated as a limit
